description: Pending implementation tasks for the remaining Round 1 and Round 2 challenge requirements. This file is a plan only; no task has been executed.

tasks.description: Capture the current local and AWS-shaped behavior before modernization.
tasks.reason: The checked-out code and Terraform definitions are out of sync in important areas, so post-change claims need a frozen behavioral reference.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the application source and record current API responses, process-local metrics, SQLite DLQ lifecycle, retry and circuit behavior, Terraform resource intent, and existing test commands. Create an evidence decision table distinguishing local SQLite/mock behavior from AWS-configured behavior. Do not execute infrastructure.

tasks.description: Expose complete latency, traffic, failure, retry, DLQ, and autoscaling visibility.
tasks.reason: The current Metrics class exposes counters and a bounded latency sample list but does not provide percentiles, rates, CloudWatch publication, or autoscaling evidence required by Round 1 and Round 2.
tasks.requirements: Addresses requirement 1. Add p50, p90, p95, and p99 latency metrics with an explicit percentile method and bounded memory/cardinality behavior. Expose request rate, error rate, retry rate, DLQ depth, circuit state/counters, and autoscaling-relevant signals through the API and CloudWatch. Preserve local testability and avoid high-cardinality borrower/event dimensions. Define metric namespaces, units, dimensions, flush/error behavior, dashboard visibility, and ECS autoscaling evidence. Acceptance requires deterministic percentile tests and metric publication contract tests; observed values must be reported rather than invented.

tasks.description: Integrate a durable AWS DLQ backend while retaining SQLite as the local default.
tasks.reason: Terraform already defines DynamoDB and SQS, but the checked-out application repository uses SQLite only; the AWS path is not implemented end to end.
tasks.requirements: Addresses requirement 2. Introduce a repository boundary with SQLite selected by default for local development and an AWS implementation selected explicitly by configuration. Persist durable DLQ records in DynamoDB and publish SQS messages containing replay/event references rather than embedding unsafe or unnecessary payload data. Implement conditional claims, status transitions, idempotency, replay success/failure updates, duplicate delivery handling, and recovery from partial operations. Align Terraform task-role permissions to least privilege for only required DynamoDB item operations, SQS send/receive/delete or visibility operations used by the application, and CloudWatch publication. Add fake-client tests plus local SQLite regression tests. Do not store secrets or resource IDs in task artifacts.

tasks.description: Add a configurable open-weight STT to LLM to TTS provider path behind the existing resilience boundary.
tasks.reason: The current provider protocol supports only a mock HTTP pipeline, while the challenge requires an open-weight provider option that does not assume GPU availability.
tasks.requirements: Addresses requirement 3. Preserve the existing PipelineProvider contract and keep retry, backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency, metrics, and DLQ decisions in their current owning layers. Add an adapter/provider boundary for a real or real-shaped STT -> LLM -> TTS path using the challenge shortlist: faster-whisper, Mistral or Llama, and Piper. Make CPU-safe operation the default fallback; allow local or internal service endpoints and dependency injection so tests do not download models or require a GPU. Define timeout/error mapping, partial-stage failure behavior, response validation, model configuration, and license/usage documentation. Acceptance requires provider contract tests, resilience integration tests, and a clear distinction between real model execution and real-shaped test doubles.

tasks.description: Document an approval-gated GPU deployment option and CPU fallback.
tasks.reason: The challenge asks for a GPU alternative, but the current deployed architecture is ECS Fargate and GPU resources must not be provisioned before approval.
tasks.requirements: Addresses requirement 4. Add a deployment option/plan for an EC2 g5.xlarge GPU alternative, preferably in ap-south-1, including networking, image/model storage, IAM, security boundaries, startup/health checks, capacity/quota checks, cost assumptions, rollback, and teardown. Document how the CPU fallback runs without GPU and why it does or does not satisfy the GPU-track requirement. Keep the option disabled by default, require explicit approval before any future provisioning, and do not create or modify GPU resources in this task.

tasks.description: Update tests, operational documentation, cost analysis, and demo evidence requirements for both rounds.
tasks.reason: The challenge requires reproducible controlled-failure evidence and updated README, runbook, cost writeup, and tests in addition to implementation code.
tasks.requirements: Addresses requirements 5 and 6. Add controlled failure/demo harnesses for 20% per-attempt dependency failure, retry recovery, final failures, circuit opening/rejection/recovery, DLQ enqueue, and replay. Capture observed attempt-level and final outcomes without faking an exact 80/20 final ratio. Update unit/integration tests for metrics, AWS repository semantics, provider stages, IAM assumptions, and replay status. Update README, RUNBOOK, COST_ANALYSIS, environment examples, and demo scripts with CPU fallback, GPU approval gates, CloudWatch/autoscaling checks, cleanup, raw evidence fields, and limitations. Define an evidence checklist with timestamps, configuration, sample size, observed rates, p50/p90/p95/p99, retries, circuit transitions, DLQ depth, replay results, and deployment identifiers where available.

tasks.description: Run post-change local and AWS-shaped verification for the challenge requirements.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requires controlled failure, recovery, circuit, DLQ, replay, metrics, provider, and deployment-option validation.
tasks.requirements: Addresses requirements 1 through 6. Validate the frozen baseline against the updated implementation using local SQLite/mock mode and mocked AWS clients; where an already-approved AWS environment exists, validate the configured DynamoDB/SQS/CloudWatch path without provisioning new GPU resources. Exercise 20% per-attempt failure input, record retries and recovery, force final failure, observe circuit transitions, inspect DLQ depth/status, replay and verify RESOLVED or FAILED transitions, verify idempotency, inspect all required latency percentiles and rates, and verify autoscaling visibility. Produce raw evidence and observed-result summaries; reject claims of exact 80/20 final results unless supported by measured data and clearly labeled.

tasks.description: Review least-privilege AWS access, model/provider supply chain, and dependency security.
tasks.reason: The AWS DLQ and metrics paths add permissions and external model/provider dependencies that must be reviewed before any future deployment approval.
tasks.requirements: Review Terraform IAM policies for least privilege and resource scoping, including DynamoDB conditional writes, SQS operations, CloudWatch metric publication, ECS execution versus task-role separation, network access, and log handling. Review Python dependencies and open-weight model/provider licenses and supply-chain risks. Confirm no credentials, borrower data, model artifacts, or sensitive payloads are committed. Record findings and required fixes; this task does not provision resources.
